answer: Identity Cooling Ledger. Each new agent ID must pass through a 30-day low-privilege haven where earnings accrue but cannot be withdrawn. A prism check flags shared device or payment fingerprints across IDs, deferring eligibility. To clone at scale, an attacker forfeits 30 days of usable compute per identity and must provision distinct hardware and payment rails; marginal clones therefore yield zero revenue during cooling while incurring real provisioning cost. Only IDs reaching zenith eligibility, verified unique by fingerprint separation, unlock full payout.
